sources.name: NASA POWER daily meteorology
sources.role: Long daily rainfall, temperature, and solar backbone; record actual parameters, time standard, spatial representation, coverage and QA.
sources.license_review: Verify applicable POWER data terms and attribution for the selected endpoint/product before redistribution.
sources.state: planned ingestion; existing M4 adapter only covers a shorter point history

sources.name: GPM IMERG precipitation
sources.role: Spatial rainfall and extreme-precipitation comparison; pin run/version and daily aggregation.
sources.license_review: Verify NASA EOSDIS product terms and attribution for the exact IMERG release.

sources.name: NASA SMAP soil moisture
sources.role: Coarse wetness context and anomalies from actual available coverage; not field workability or root-zone truth.
sources.license_review: Verify exact SMAP product terms, quality flags, and attribution.

sources.name: MODIS NDVI (candidate MOD13Q1 collection 6.1)
sources.role: QA-masked vegetation/green-up composite context; not an exact transplanting date.
sources.license_review: Verify selected NASA/USGS LP DAAC product terms, attribution, and derived-product redistribution conditions.
sources.state: planned; exact collection must be pinned

sources.name: Landsat surface reflectance and temperature products
sources.role: Finer land-cover, vegetation, and stress context after cloud/shadow masking and sampling checks.
sources.license_review: Verify exact USGS/NASA collection and terms before redistribution.
sources.state: planned; exact product must be selected

sources.name: ECOSTRESS temperature and evapotranspiration products
sources.role: Acquisition-time heat and ET context; preserve retrieval limitations and gaps.
sources.license_review: Verify exact product terms and attribution before release.

sources.name: GRACE and GRACE-FO water-storage anomalies
sources.role: Regional long-term water-storage context only; never district groundwater volume or field detail.
sources.license_review: Verify exact processing-center product terms and attribution.

sources.name: SRTM elevation
sources.role: Terrain/elevation context; does not prove flood risk, infiltration, or erosion rate.
sources.license_review: Verify exact SRTM product terms and attribution.

sources.name: GEDI biomass and structure samples
sources.role: Sampled biomass/agroforestry context where coverage exists; not annual-crop soil carbon or universal biomass.
sources.license_review: Verify exact GEDI product terms and attribution.

sources.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate scenarios
sources.role: Predictive scenario exploration with scenario/model/baseline/period and ensemble spread distinct from observations and forecasts.
sources.license_review: Verify exact dataset terms and redistribution conditions for each downloaded file.

sources.name: Bangladesh local agronomy, soil, crop calendar, market, and resource evidence
sources.role: Sourced local context with exact claim-level provenance and review; distinguish farmer-reported from lab-tested data.
sources.license_review: Verify source-specific copyright, reuse, and attribution; no blanket license is assumed.

sources.name: Canonical district boundaries and crop/land-cover masks
sources.role: Versioned district aggregation geometry and crop mask; reuse M1 identifiers and retain weights/CRS.
sources.license_review: Select and verify the exact boundary/mask owner, version, license, and redistribution rights before ingesting; do not treat an unreviewed geometry as approved.
sources.state: planned; M1 canonical IDs are authoritative; source product selection remains open
